name: Daite...
source:
A girl approaches the hero one day with words "Please embrace me". Hero invites her to a hotel only knowing her name Igarashi Ai.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一名女孩走近英雄，说道“请拥抱我”。英雄邀请她去一家旅馆，只知道她的名字五十岚爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
